notes.title: Showcase Patch #3
notes.content:
Official [b]FSR 3.1[/b] Support added to the game!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44428010/b91679b2d9c84209ab5242c6cb37a64199a21552.gif[/img]

[olist]
[*] FSR Up scaling
[*] Frame Generation with FSR

Frame Generation only works with [b]FSR Upscaling Enabled[/b], if not it will be ignored.

[i] Enjoy Up scaling on all graphics cards [/i]
